info.name: Invoice Process - API Verification
info.description:
Actify Invoice Process - API verification collection (API-only backend; no web pages are served).

NOT LIVE-TESTED: this collection was rewritten on 2026-10-27 from the source code and the automated tests; it has
not yet been run against a running application.

Authentication: "00 - Login" first. GET /api/health (public) obtains the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie; POST
/api/auth/login sets the HttpOnly INVOICE_PROCESS_AUTH cookie and ROTATES the XSRF token. A collection-level test
script copies the current XSRF-TOKEN cookie into the collection variable xsrfToken after EVERY response, and the
collection pre-request script sends it as X-XSRF-TOKEN on every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE. CSRF is never disabled.
Set adminEmail / adminPassword in the environment (a TEST admin only - never a real person's account).

Safety:
- Read-only, safe to repeat: 00, 01, 05, 07, 11 and 10a/10-0/10f/10g/10h.
- WRITES data (no Gemini call): 02 (creates a batch and stores a PDF), 04 (records rejected files on that batch),
  08 (stores a second PDF and closes the batch), 10b (new invoice version). Run them manually against a demo or
  test database only.
- No request calls Gemini. Extraction happens only in the server's background worker, which is OFF unless the
  server owner enables it (INVOICE_WORKER_ENABLED + GEMINI_API_KEY + limits). Enabling it is a separate, approved
  step; folders 03 and 09 then show extraction results, otherwise the invoices simply stay QUEUED.
- The legacy POST /api/invoices/extract endpoint is not used: it answers 409 in the local demo and on Render.

Files: the PDF fixtures (samples/*, postman/fixtures/*) are NOT in the repository. Provide your own SYNTHETIC files
under those names and set Postman Settings > General > Working directory to the project folder. oversized.pdf must
be larger than 10 MB. No Gemini key is needed or stored here: the backend owns it.

item.name: 06 - Provider failure scenarios (verified by the automated tests, not from Postman)
item.description: Gemini failures cannot be triggered from Postman without spending quota. They are covered by the offline JUnit suite with Gemini mocked (./mvnw -o test): GeminiInvoiceExtractorTest, InvoiceServiceImplTest, FailureClassifierTest, ExtractionWorkerDecisionTest and InvoiceControllerTest. In the batch workflow a provider failure never becomes an HTTP error: the invoice is retried (QUEUED) or ends FAILED with a failureReason. Never hammer Gemini to force a real 429.
